one_line: Anthropic completes a historic IPO, infrastructure investments surge, and regulatory scrutiny intensifies around chip exports and safety systems.

themes.title: Anthropic completes record-breaking IPO
themes.text: Anthropic went public with an $81.3 billion initial public offering, valuing the company at roughly $1.7 trillion while retail allocation is expected to fall below 20%. Early investor Dustin Moskovitz noted his stake will be worth billions and reiterated that frontier labs should slow down rather than race.

stories.headline: Anthropic raises $81.3B in record-breaking IPO as founders cash out $2B
Early Anthropic investor Dustin Moskovitz says labs should slow down
Anthropic IPO retail investor allocation expected to fall below 20%

themes.title: Data center and hardware investments grow
themes.text: The IEA projected global data center investment to reach $4 trillion by 2030, while OpenAI and AMD used AI to cut the chip design process to under five months. Meanwhile, Beijing-based MegaRobo raised nearly $200 million for AI-driven lab automation.

stories.headline: IEA projects global data center investment to reach $4T by 2030
MegaRobo raises nearly $200 million for AI-driven lab automation
OpenAI and AMD cut chip design process to under five months using AI

themes.title: Scrutiny grows over chip exports and Nvidia
themes.text: The US Commerce Department approved sales of over 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies, and a congressional report noted China's military seeks Nvidia chips for AI weapons. Additionally, California AG Rob Bonta issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia regarding former CEO Jensen Huang.

stories.headline: US Commerce Dept approved sales of over 879K AI chips to Chinese companies
California AG subpoenas Nvidia over former CEO Jensen Huang's affair
China's military seeks Nvidia chips for AI weapons, report says

themes.title: Agents expand to desktop and macOS
themes.text: Google added a computer use feature to Gemini for macOS to complete tasks across apps and the web. Apple is also hiring engineers to build an autonomous AI agent for web browsing, coding, and calling services.

stories.headline: Google adds computer use to Gemini for macOS
Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
